notes: eighteen is treated as a fusion of רִבּוֹ and שְׁמוֹנַת with the intervening waw unrepresented under rule 42's surplus count; the alternative gives eighteen to שְׁמוֹנַת alone and leaves רִבּוֹ unrepresented, which would drop the larger of the two numerals.
The article of בֵּית הָאֱלֹהִים takes the the standing before house, exactly as rule 29 reads אֹצְרוֹת בֵּית הָאֱלֹהִים, while עֲבוֹדַת takes a supplied one.
